About LYSM

The Laboratory

The Laboratoire Ypatia des Sciences Mathématiques is an Italo-French mathematical research laboratory established through collaboration between the Centre National de la Recherche Scientifique (CNRS), the Consiglio Nazionale delle Ricerche (CNR), and the Istituto Nazionale di Alta Matematica (INdAM). It has become a cornerstone of Franco-Italian collaboration in the mathematical sciences, fostering joint projects, workshops, and intellectual exchange between the two communities.

Our Mission

LYSM is dedicated to fostering excellence in mathematical research through international collaboration between France and Italy, promoting interdisciplinary approaches to contemporary mathematical problems, and creating an environment where researchers from both countries — and beyond — can work together to solve fundamental questions in mathematics. At the heart of its mission is the strengthening of the Franco-Italian mathematical community, building on a rich history of bilateral collaborations and serving as a catalyst for joint projects, workshops, and intellectual exchange between the two nations.
